title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 22
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 22: David at Adullam's cave, Doeg's report and the slaughter of the priests of Nob.

questions.text: Where did David escape to when he departed from there?
questions.explanation: David departed from there and escaped to Adullam's cave.

questions.text: About how many men were with David when he became their captain?
questions.explanation: Those in distress, in debt and discontented gathered to him, and there were with him about four hundred men.

questions.text: Whom did David ask the king of Moab to take in?
questions.explanation: David said to the king of Moab, "Please let my father and my mother come out with you."

questions.text: Which prophet told David not to stay in the stronghold?
questions.explanation: The prophet Gad told David to depart and go into the land of Judah.

questions.text: Where was Saul sitting when he heard that David was discovered?
questions.explanation: Saul was sitting in Gibeah, under the tamarisk tree in Ramah, with his spear in his hand.

answers.text: At the gate of the city
On his throne in the palace
Beside the great well in Secu

questions.text: Who told Saul that he had seen David coming to Ahimelech at Nob?
questions.explanation: Doeg the Edomite said, "I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub."

questions.text: How did Ahimelech describe David to Saul?
questions.explanation: Ahimelech said David was the king's son-in-law, captain of his body guard and honored in his house.

answers.text: As the king's son-in-law and captain of his body guard
As the king's cupbearer and his chief scribe
As a runaway servant who rebelled against the king
As a stranger he had never met before

questions.text: How did the king's guard respond when Saul ordered them to kill the priests?
questions.explanation: The servants of the king would not put out their hand to fall on the priests of Yahweh.

answers.text: They killed the priests at once
They refused to touch the priests
They brought the priests to Gibeah

questions.text: How many people who wore a linen ephod did Doeg kill that day?
questions.explanation: Doeg the Edomite attacked the priests and killed on that day eighty-five people who wore a linen ephod.

questions.text: Which son of Ahimelech escaped and fled after David?
questions.explanation: One of the sons of Ahimelech, named Abiathar, escaped and fled after David.
